text:
alice: Quick heads-up — we're planning a coordinated minor bump across repos: runtime -> 0.14.2, api -> 1.7.0, console -> 0.9.0, sdk-js -> 2.3.0. Cutoff is TOMORROW 18:00 PT. Please confirm compat & changelogs.
ben: copying notes here — is the runtime change breaking?
carol: runtime tweak is a perf flag default change, not a public API. Should be safe but need integration smoke.
dave: I'll run the smoke tests against api + runtime. Pushing a PR for the runtime bump in a few mins (GH #742).
erin: console needs a small telemetry field rename; will open changelog entry and PR today.
frank: sdk-js should be patch-only. Queueing PR to update package.json and docs.
alice: thanks. Can folks run the quick interop script before cutoff? Saves us last-minute surprises.
ben: running now. command I use:```bash
./scripts/run-integration.sh --repos runtime api console sdk-js --smoke --timeout 20m
```
carol: FYI I saw an intermittent failing test on api auth header in CI — not sure if related. @dave can you check auth integration in your pass?
dave: yep caught that — it's a flake in the test harness, not the header contract. Re-ran, passed.
release-bot: Deploy window reminder: coordinated bumps cutoff in 23 hours. See https://redwood.build/release-calendar
alice: ok, action items: dave finish smoke + link PRs, erin add console changelog bullet, frank update sdk docs, carol confirm flaky test fixed, ben verify perf numbers (latency p50/p95). Reply here when done. :thumbsup:
ben: perf numbers look good — p50 unchanged, p95 down 6% after flag. Screenshot in PR.
frank: PR up: #1284 (sdk-js bump + docs).
dave: runtime PR is open: #742. Just kicked CI and smoke passed locally.
erin: console changelog added in #560, small note about telemetry rename.
carol: re-ran flaky test with the harness fix, all green.
alice: perfect. If no blockers by 15:00 PT tomorrow we cut. Thanks all.
frank: if someone can +1 the sdk docs, I'll merge and tag.
dave: +1 from me.
ben: +1
alice: merging checklist complete — proceeding to tag at 15:05 PT unless someone objects.
frank: no objections.
release-bot: Tags created: runtime@0.14.2, api@1.7.0, console@0.9.0, sdk-js@2.3.0. [automated]
alice: release tags pushed and changelogs published. Great work, team! :tada:
